# Muhammad Furnitures

> Muhammad Furnitures is a furniture maker in Pakistan. We build sofa sets, beds, wardrobes, dining tables, office desks, TV units, centre tables, dressing tables and bookshelves to order, to your size, colour and finish. Prices are in Pakistani rupees (Rs).
